subject: Note-decay B: reinforce lane — lift confidence/structBoost for notes recalled-and-won
description:
The POSITIVE mirror of #1's retire lane (together = 're-grade by usefulness'). Forks off orch/feature/note-decay.

SCOPE: Read the recall-outcome consumer from #1. For notes recalled into APPROVED/tested tasks, apply a GRADED reinforcement to the note's retrieval weight (structBoost) and/or a confidence score — YourMemory-style recall boost but graded on OUTCOME (recalled-and-won), not mere access. Decay-on-disuse (#1) + reinforce-on-payoff (this) are the two halves. Keep boosts BOUNDED (no runaway), idempotent, and observable (log the lift per note). Tests. Commit onto orch/attempt/<key> before complete_task.

summary:
Implemented note-decay reinforce lane (pass 5) across 5 files, all 34 new tests pass alongside 71 existing decay tests:

1. lib/recall-outcome-journal.js — added REINFORCE_WIN_RATE_THRESHOLD=0.75, REINFORCE_MAX_BOOST=0.2, computeNoteBoost(noteKey, statsOrMap) with linear ramp formula; also exported previously-missing CORROBORATION_MIN+isCorroborated.

2. lib/judge.js — imported computeNoteBoost; added pass 5 reinforce lane in buildQueue(): iterates current (validTo==null) note_nodes, calls computeNoteBoost(), emits {kind:'reinforce', action:'boost', noteId, boost, winRate, total} items sorted after decay items.

3. routes/judge.js — serializes 'reinforce' items in /judge/next (same shape as decay but with boost field); handles boostNote verdict in POST /judge/verdict — calls graphStore.appendEvent with note_reinforced event, increments applied.reinforced.

4. lib/graph-store.js — added case 'note_reinforced': accumulates ev.boost into node.reinforceBoost, sets node.reinforceWinRate when ev.winRate is defined.

5. test/note-decay-reinforce.test.js — 34 plain-Node tests covering computeNoteBoost formula/gates (A), buildQueue reinforce lane gate conditions (B), and note_reinforced event behavior in graph-store (C).
